headline: Language-model embeddings are paired with geometric and physical constraints for binding and stability prediction
label: Physics Aware Protein Language Models
summary: Current JCIM and preprint work couples ESM-type embeddings with antisymmetry, local geometry and calibrated uncertainty for ΔΔG, affinity and kinetics.
synthesis: The dominant thread is conditioning pretrained sequence representations, or lightweight alternatives, on physical or chemical structure for interaction and stability endpoints. FamGeo-DDG combines ESM-2 with DSSP and local mutation-centered geometry, MutBindPred imposes antisymmetric constraints on ΔΔG, and BlindDDG recasts stability as direction-of-change classification with a Siamese network. MGCA pairs ESM2 with Morgan fingerprints in a cross-attention mixture-of-experts for Koff. RAVEN uses frozen random graph reservoirs with physics-informed interaction fingerprints, and STORM targets affinity without structure. New relative to static-structure work is the emphasis on symmetry constraints, kinetic endpoints, frozen or small backbones, and uncertainty: dependence-aware conformal prediction gives 3D docking boxes. Several items are peptide or generative applications of the same language-model and reinforcement learning toolkit.
